subject: Tenant epoch keyring audit & cross-region key-eviction request
messages:
From: Sara Finch <sara.finch@aurorafin.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@aurorafin.com
Date: 2028-06-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Tenant epoch keyring audit + cross-region key eviction

Hi Ben,

Per our SOC 2 prep runbook, the audit team is asking for a short artifact set demonstrating how Redwood performs a cross-region key eviction for a tenant 'epoch' keyring (we're calling it the epoch keyring that is rotated for ephemeral TLS/wrapping). Specifically we need: 

- A concise timeline of a recent eviction event (UTC timestamps) showing HSM operator actions and KMS policy transitions.
- The S3 manifest or wrapped-key list that shows the replaced WRAP keys (sanitized is fine).
- Evidence that old KEKs are no longer accessible after eviction (operator logs or KMS ACL snapshot).

We plan to include these in our CAIQ/SIG appendix. Do you have a sample event we can reference and a small packet you can share by EOD Pacific tomorrow?

Thanks,
Sara Finch
Security Audit Lead
AuroraFin

[Attachment: aurorafin-soc2-preamble.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Finch <sara.finch@aurorafin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-07T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant epoch keyring audit + cross-region key eviction

Sara — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Marissa (ops) and Kim (security) who own the artifact package and the HSM ops traces.

Quick note on scope: we can provide a sanitized manifest and HSM shift logs plus a short narrative timeline. We will not include any plaintext keys; everything will be wrapped or hashed. If you need sign-offs on retention windows, please flag that now.

Kim / Marissa — can you assemble: 
1) a redacted cross-region eviction manifest (wrapped-key identifiers, no raw material),
2) HSM operator shiftlog slice showing the CSI (ceremony id) and operator IDs, and
3) an ACL snapshot showing the KEK policy transition?

I told Sara we can get a compact packet by EOD tomorrow.

Ben
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: request-summary.txt (text/plain)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sara Finch <sara.finch@aurorafin.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant epoch keyring audit + cross-region key eviction

Thanks Ben — pulling artifacts now. Per Sara's ask, here's what we'll include in the deliverable and why: 

1) crossregion-eviction-manifest.jsonl (sanitized): list of wrapped-key IDs, target region, source region, operation id (opaque), timestamp UTC. This demonstrates which wrapped keys were replaced during the eviction.

2) hsm-shiftlog-20280607.txt: operator shift entries with event markers for the KEK unbind/bind sequence and ceremony UUIDs. We will redact operator session tokens but keep operator IDs and timestamps.

3) keystore-epoch-audit-sample.csv: sampling of key metadata (key_id, wrap_algo, created_at, retired_at, replacement_key_id, retention_policy_tag). This is CSV with hashed key ids.

4) short narrative (text) describing policy transitions: KMS policy before eviction, temporary deny, rewrap policy, and final allow.

Request for audit scope confirmation: Sara, do you need a signed attestation from our HSM vendor (YubiHSM/Thales attestation) or is the operator shiftlog + manifest sufficient for your SIG appendix?

Planned delivery: link to a secure drive folder + JIRA ticket (JIRA-RI-8421).

Marissa Cole
Platform Security Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: keystore-epoch-audit-sample.csv (text/csv)]

From: Sara Finch <sara.finch@aurorafin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@aurorafin.com
Date: 2028-06-09T16:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant epoch keyring audit + cross-region key eviction

Marissa — this is exactly what we need, thank you. A couple of follow-ups before you drop the folder: 

- Please include a short CSV column explaining how the hashed key_id maps to the record we see in our tenant manifest (we only need the mapping table per sample record, not the full mapping).
- If possible, include a one-paragraph note from HSM ops confirming that retired KEKs are purged from HSM slot indexing after the eviction (a single-signer sentence on letterhead is enough).

If you can upload to the secure drive link and post the JIRA-RI-8421 note, we'll pull into our CAIQ appendix. Appreciate the quick turnaround — will mark this done in our SOC 2 tracker once we have the artifacts.

Best,
Sara Finch
Security Audit Lead
AuroraFin

[Attachment: SOC2-checklist-row.pdf (application/pdf)]
